Overview.Name: Praveena Enukonda
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (medium bowl) & salad (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry & salad
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (60 g) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & grilled chicken (small portion)

Notes_and_Tips: Since thyroid and migraine are present, keep meal timings regular and avoid long gaps without food.
Salads can be included daily to improve digestion and keep meals light.
Sweet cravings during social gatherings can be managed by eating protein first before desserts.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to reduce migraine triggers and support better sleep.
Simple home style cooking will help maintain consistency and steady energy.
